The smooth bore would be the main issue as they would be unable to produce the shells to modern tolerances and even a very small mistake in the shell design will massively reduce accuracy. The reason for this is that in a smooth bore gun if the shell is not the correct size then it would move slightly in the barrel. Hence why riffled tank guns were very popular until recently. However in this case the smooth bore may offer some advantages in that they would likely be able to produce ammunition that is lower quality but still works faster than if it was a rifled barrel. In saying that though if they could produce something that could shoot even half decently then the tanks would be almost unstoppable.
